review: O03-2 independent visual and lifecycle review

scope.method: Read-only C++/XML comparison and review of existing, archived public-field QtTest evidence and PNG captures.

conclusion.result: No blocking embedding, leave-page, logout or session-consistency regression established in the archived O03-2 snapshot inspected first. This is a static review supported by earlier owner-run tests, not fresh execution or acceptance of the concurrently changing O03-3 sources.

visual_review.account_and_user_container_xml: After only PingFang-to-Noto font-family normalization, frmaccountsetting.ui and frmuserset.ui match reference XML.
visual_review.main_ui_xml_differences: Five QLabel border-image URLs replace ./resource/main_state/*.png with :/shell/main_state/*.png; no additional widget property difference after font-family normalization.

runtime_geometry_static_basis.finding: Original 1920x1080 logical canvas retained; logo follows original documented 82x82 centering.
Embedded mode disables independent-host centering and restores the original root group positions x10/y30 and x410/y30.
Embedded hospital restores original panel x330/y10, 801x551 and hides its experiment footer.

visual_review.observed_from_images: O03-2 places the original account table/form in the existing white user-settings body and retains the original shell navigation/status regions. Guest capture is taken after a rejected delete attempt; its newly entered offlineSend name is not proof of stale logout cache (test lines 786-795).
visual_review.original_runtime_comparison: Not established; retained source geometry/styles and WSL captures alone do not prove active Windows release theme, exact font metrics or RK screen equivalence.

lifecycle_checks.invariant: Exactly one page of each type, original indices account=0 and hospital=1
lifecycle_checks.assessment: Preserved; replaces the original placeholder rather than accumulating insertWidget copies.

lifecycle_checks.invariant: Busy operation rejects navigation/logout/close; hospital draft cancel preserves data and discard performs no database write
lifecycle_checks.assessment: Owner-run evidence covers user/main navigation, manual logout and shell close during locked account write, plus cancel/accept hospital draft paths. Busy account is checked before asking to discard a hospital draft.

lifecycle_checks.invariant: Single session source and consistent hidden account page
lifecycle_checks.assessment: Shell and account UI consume AccountStore::sessionChanged. Hidden page immediately refilters displayedRows_; unauthenticated session clears names/passwords/rows. No duplicate shell-side role mutation is introduced.

lifecycle_checks.invariant: Manual logout is acknowledged asynchronously and locks pending navigation
lifecycle_checks.assessment: Manual logout retains original allowance during simulated running state, while adding offline write/draft guards. CLI simulated authentication and omission of original production login popup are explicit scope differences.

lifecycle_checks.invariant: Automatic update/delete-current logout does not use the manual draft guard
lifecycle_checks.assessment: Worker-cleared identity propagates before operation completion; shell does not queue a second logout or run a draft-discard navigation path. Success-popup/session ordering differs from the original and is already documented.

Exact unusual role filter, administrator invalid update index mapping to role 0, double-click replacement of read-only names and equality-based running-state rule remain. Shell Guest label 访客 has direct original main.cpp:715-716 basis; no general user_powers ACL inferred.

lifecycle_checks.invariant: Worker-owned storage closes before thread shutdown and no duplicate instances
lifecycle_checks.assessment: Existing formal exit log records HOSPITAL_STORE_CLOSED, ACCOUNT_STORE_CLOSED, THREADS_STOPPED true, EXIT code=0; two-process public readback matches. No authentication database was opened in this independent review.

findings.status: reported to parent; owner may correct evidence
findings.claim: committed logout also clears username/row caches and resets the add tab
findings.source_evidence: ui/frmaccountsetting.cpp:215-227 resetForLogout clears fields, rows and role options, but does not change stkAccount/current tab or btnMenuAdd.
findings.reproducible_sequence: Select Delete or Update, then manually log out while idle (or delete the current account). The account page keeps the selected tab while identity/editor caches clear. No new execution was performed here.
findings.consequence: The archived statement overclaims an unimplemented tab reset. This is not established as a product regression because retaining the selected tab agrees with the absence of a tab reset in the original logout refresh.
findings.correction: Correct the archived sentence to describe cache cleanup with selected tab preserved; do not change source solely to match an inaccurate audit sentence.

evidence_limits.evidence: offline_shell_account_20261023/write_result.json response.heartbeat.max_ms=1556.009424; validation_summary.json:89 and original_layout_audit.json:2977 explicitly retain it as unlocalized.
evidence_limits.narrower_evidence: navigation_focus.json:100 navigation samples, navigation p95=22.961638 ms/max=25.09155 ms; heartbeat max=48.589979 ms, after an explicit 10 ms event-loop interval between transitions.
evidence_limits.assessment: Focused navigation evidence supports that load only. It does not eliminate or explain the 1.556 s integrated-workload gap, and does not prove full-workflow no-stall acceptance.

evidence_limits.evidence: All 87 compared widget declarations preserve name/class/geometry, font substitution is explicit; archived WSL screenshots were viewed. No original active-release Windows runtime screenshot baseline is present in the reviewed evidence.
evidence_limits.assessment: Static preservation is supported; complete original runtime color/font/disabled/modal state equivalence remains pending.

evidence_limits.evidence: formal_app_exit.json proves formal 1600x900 host startup/normal exit only; saved account screenshots are 1920x1080 QWidget grabs. shell/main.cpp:22-41 retains an external scroll host.
evidence_limits.assessment: Complete small-host scroll/right-side interactions, physical RK display/input, real device state, production authentication/global ACL and long stability remain outside current evidence. These limitations were already explicitly retained, not newly introduced defects.

concurrent_source_drift.read_only_increment_observation: Later source adds O03-3 HistoryPage/HistoryStore declarations, --history startup and history leave/status/worker shutdown integration. This is a separate expanded scope in progress. Existing O03-2 archived run evidence cannot be claimed as execution of these newer hashes.
concurrent_source_drift.required_interpretation: All line-number references above point to the initial archived O03-2 snapshot. Account UI and frmUserSet files remained unchanged at the final check. Owner must correlate and rerun accumulated validation after O03-3 source freeze; this independent task did not launch builds or GUI.

exclusions: No production/reference database, credentials or secret file was read.
No source, build, resource, documentation or archived evidence file was modified.
No build, test program or GUI was launched.
Data-layer implementation was not re-audited for authentication correctness; this review only follows public signals and public-field archived results.
